item: AP calls Colorado's governor race for Democrat Phil Weiser at poll close; NBC News and Decision Desk HQ also project him. DDHQ projects Democrat Rob Sand wins Iowa's governor race and Republican Alan Wilson wins South Carolina's; both await a second call here.
source: AP via KDVR/Axios; NBC News; DDHQ via The Hill/WBTW

item: AP and Fox News call Colorado's Senate race for Democratic Sen. John Hickenlooper over Republican Mark Baisley (Hickenlooper 60.98%, Baisley 35.05%, 64% in per Fox News).
AP and Fox News call New Mexico's Senate race for Democratic Sen. Ben Ray Luján over Republican Larry Marker.
source: AP (via WUSA9, GV Wire); Fox News

item: AP calls Wyoming's Senate race for Republican Harriet Hageman over Democrat James Byrd.
AP calls West Virginia's Senate race for Republican Sen. Shelley Moore Capito over Democrat Rachel Fetty Anderson; Fox News also calls it.
AP and Fox News call Oklahoma's Senate race for Republican Kevin Hern over Democrat N'Kiyla Thomas.
NBC News and Fox News call Tennessee's Senate race for Republican Sen. Bill Hagerty over Democrat Marquita Bradshaw.
AP calls Rhode Island's governor race for Democrat Helena Foulkes.
AP calls New York's governor race for Democratic Gov. Kathy Hochul, joining CBS News; shown as won here.
AP projects Republican Eric Barlow wins Wyoming's governor race over Democrat Ken Casner.
NBC News projects Republican Byron Donalds wins Florida's governor race (AP count: Donalds 50.1%, Jolly 48.6%, about 99% counted). Shown as counting here until a second outlet's call is confirmed.
source: NBC News; AP count via Yahoo News

item: Ohio Senate tightens: Democrat Sherrod Brown 48.25%, Republican Sen. Jon Husted 47.00%, with 73% of expected vote in.

Local outlets report Democrats Phil Weiser (Colorado), Ned Lamont (Connecticut) and Rob Sand (Iowa) have won governor races; the calling outlets were not confirmed in this check, so these are not yet shown as won.
source: Colorado Sun, Axios Denver, WTNH, The Hill

item: Texas: Democrat James Talarico leads Republican Ken Paxton 59.7% to 38.8% in the Senate race with an AP-estimated 52% counted; Democrat Gina Hinojosa leads Gov. Greg Abbott 56.6% to 42.1% with about 40% counted. Neither race is called.
source: Texas Tribune (AP data) via Victoria Advocate; NBC News (AP data)

item: Michigan Senate early returns: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed 55%, Republican Mike Rogers 43%, with about 4% of the vote counted.

The Associated Press calls Kentucky's Senate race for Republican Andy Barr over Democrat Charles Booker (Barr 53.6%, Booker 44.2%, 72% counted), confirming earlier ABC News and Decision Desk HQ projections.
NBC News projects Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms wins Georgia's governor race over Republican Rick Jackson, flipping a Republican-held seat. Shown as counting here until a second outlet confirms.
CBS News projects Democratic Gov. Kathy Hochul wins re-election in New York over Republican Bruce Blakeman. Shown as counting here until a second outlet confirms.
NBC News projects Democratic Gov. Wes Moore wins re-election in Maryland, matching Fox News's earlier call; shown as won here.
Some outlets report Republican Byron Donalds is projected to win Florida's governor race; no AP or major-network call was confirmed in this check, so it stays uncalled here.
ABC News projects Republican Andy Barr wins Kentucky's Senate race over Democrat Charles Booker (Barr 54%, Booker 44%, 56% of expected vote in), matching Decision Desk HQ; shown as called here.
ABC News projects Democrat Chris Pappas wins New Hampshire's Senate race, joining Fox News; shown as won here (Pappas 59%, Sununu 39%, 25% in).

Fox News calls Florida's Senate special election for Republican Sen. Ashley Moody over Democrat Angie Nixon (Moody 50.77%, Nixon 48.09%, 96% in). Decision Desk HQ has also projected Moody, so it is shown as called here.
source: Fox News, Decision Desk HQ (via Mediaite)

item: Florida's governor race remains uncalled: Republican Byron Donalds 49.90%, Democrat David Jolly 48.85%, with about 96% counted.
Fox News calls New Hampshire's Senate race for Democrat Chris Pappas. Shown as counting here until a second outlet confirms.

Fox News calls Massachusetts's governor race for Democrat Maura Healey, matching NBC News's projection; shown as won here. Fox also called Maryland's governor race for Democrat Wes Moore, awaiting a second call.

The Hill reports Republican Sen. Ashley Moody is projected to win Florida's Senate special election over Democrat Angie Nixon. AP and NBC News had not called it as of this check, so it stays uncalled here.
AP calls North Carolina's Senate race for Democrat Roy Cooper over Republican Michael Whatley, flipping a Republican-held seat.
AP projects Democratic Gov. JB Pritzker wins re-election in Illinois, confirming NBC News's earlier projection.

AP called Senate races for Democrats at poll close: Chris Coons (Delaware), Juliana Stratton (Illinois), Ed Markey (Massachusetts), Cory Booker (New Jersey) and Jack Reed (Rhode Island). Shown as won here now that AP and NBC News agree.
